description: This Dart file defines the Recipe class, a data model used within a mobile application to represent recipes. It includes fields such as id, title, image, tags, description, ingredients, steps, and rating. The class provides methods for creating instances from a map, converting instances to a map, and parsing a list of recipes from JSON string.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: A data model representing a recipe with various attributes such as id, title, image, tags, description, ingredients, steps, and rating. It includes methods for serialization and deserialization from Map and JSON.

methods.name: Recipe.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Recipe instance from a Map<String, dynamic>, parsing and assigning each field appropriately.

methods.name: Recipe.toMap
methods.description: Converts a Recipe instance into a Map<String, dynamic> for serialization.

methods.name: Recipe.listFromJson
methods.description: Static method that takes a JSON string representing a list of recipes, decodes it, and returns a list of Recipe objects.
